$meta.name: Travel app design tokens - sprint 4 additions
$meta.status: Approved by Raz with changes (README section 19.1); changes applied. DELTA ONLY on top of 0.4.0: every key below is new; no existing value changes. Merge into docs/design/tokens.json and apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same PR that first uses them (docs/design/sprint-04/README.md section 16). Keys starting with '$check.' are contrast documentation only and are not merged into tokens.ts.
color.entry.note: Entry tags (README 5.1). banned = status.alert.bg/fg (Raz approved red for 'no entry' and NSC level 4 only; extend design-system.md 1.3); restricted = Sunset 50/700 light, bg.tag/Sunset 300 dark. Always a word plus an icon (no-entry circle / warning triangle), never colour only. allowed = no tag.
color.advisory.note: All filled segments take the level's colour; empty segments are a 1pt outline in advisory.empty with no fill. Bars fill from the start edge (flexDirection row, flips in RTL). Always next to words. Level-4 text uses text.alert; levels 1-3 text.primary. Level 3 is amber (not Sunset, Raz). Four states per ADR-008: (a) level 1-4 from nsc_levels (last value; 'up to' + 'varies by region' when length > 1), (b) NSC text but nsc_levels empty: no bar, tappable, (c) no row or fetched_at null: 'pending', no bar, no date; the separate 'no published warning' state is merged into level 1. The card row always shows 'Checked {{date}}' (footnote), with the stale tag after timing.advisory.staleAfterDays (README 6.1-6.3).
format.rate.note: units = smallest of format.rate.units with rateToIls*units >= 0.1, compared before rounding. ils = toPrecision(2) of rateToIls*units, usd = toPrecision(2) of rateToIls*units/usdIls (from the unrounded value), trailing zeros kept; values >= 100 rounded to 2 significant digits as an integer, never exponent notation. ISO code, not symbol. Thousands with ',' and decimal '.' in both languages. rateParts() returns { amount, ils, usd } (unit-tested); the component joins them into one Text in one LRI…PDI isolate, with U+00A0 inside each part and a single U+0020 only before '·', so the line can only break before '·' (component-tested). USD: '1 USD = x ₪'. ILS: null, no line (README 3).
limits.calc.note: '.' and ',' are both the decimal separator; ',' is shown as '.'. A leading separator ('.5') is accepted. No thousands separators in any field (required). A rejected single keystroke is ignored silently; a rejected multi-character change (paste) keeps the previous value and shows calc.invalid. Computed fields: 2 decimals, no grouping; more than 12 integer digits shows an em dash (README 4.2, 4.3).
timing.stale.note: Device clock against fetched_at, checked on each render (no timer). Rates and advisories are fetched once per app session; if that fails, one retry when the next card opens (ADR-008).
search.main.note: Countries first (unchanged), then up to 5 cities by population from 2 normalised characters. Group headers only when both groups show. Cities fade in over 150 ms (standard) without moving the countries. The global city index loads when search opens. City row: Hebrew 'city, country' + English name line; English one line 'City, Country' (displayName per language, territories included) (README 9).
layout.card.scrollModeRule: Scroll mode when passHeight + COUPON_CHROME + size.tripRow.min > maxCardHeight: pass and coupon in one ScrollView with maxHeight, coupon list unbounded, close button fixed with a 40pt bg.surfaceRaised circle, open trip row scrolled to 16pt below the top; the outer ScrollView calls the coupon's loadMore callback 48pt from its end (not in cached mode). COUPON_CHROME is computed: 108 plus the cached-copy notice (~30) when shown (README 1.2, 1.3).
$check.contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), on the hex values in tokens.json. Text 4.5:1, graphics 3:1 (1.4.11).
$check.contrast.level3.amber: #B45309 L=0.159; #FFA94D L=0.502. Both pass 3:1 on bg.surfaceRaised and on the open-row background in their theme.
